out_of_domain_policy: Not axis-based by construction: the fixtures are wavelength-independent analytic constants with no tabulated axes, so no extrapolation concept applies. Their domain is USAGE-based: consumption by any predictive path is a hard error regardless of wavelength; synthetic regression contexts only.
provenance: FIRE_SMOKE_DESIGN.md SS12 'Phase-function form / provisional optics fixtures' (lines ~4287-4294 at r45+): values quoted verbatim from the design's closed decision; design-owned, not literature-derived. E=0.26 is the SS12 Phase-A analytic default/regression fixture (Dalzell-Sarofim m=1.57-0.56i -> E=0.2595, quoted as 0.26).
semantics: These values exist to exercise chromatic transport and constituent mixing in regression tests. They are NOT physical presets, satisfy no SS1 requirement, and must NEVER be consumed by a predictive path. Distinct record ID from the predictive presets is REQUIRED (owner ruling 2026-08-05) so fixture and preset provenance cannot be confused.
